dana_cs: Heads-up: Harbor Lane plans private VPC cutover next Monday. Compliance flagged three must-haves before we flip: (1) explicit KMS cross-account policy with scoped actions, (2) audit log retention policy (5y immutable), (3) confirmation that all model input fields are redacted before egress. They said renewal could be delayed if any of these aren't documented. Any blockers?

kai_net: Network status: TGW attachment live. We created an S3 gateway endpoint (vpce-0f1e2d3c) and added a route. Need to add SG rule to allow outbound TLS to collector.redwood.internal:443. Recommend endpoint over NAT to hit latency targets.

brenda_security: KMS update: we spun up a customer key alias/harbor/logs (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888899990000:key/hbr-222). Harbor must add our logging role arn:aws:iam::999900001111:role/redwood-logging to their key policy with Encrypt and GenerateDataKey. They asked to avoid cross-account Decrypt. Proposed snippet I sent to their cloud-admin includes an EncryptionContext requirement to bind usage to project=harbor. Snippet below for reference:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLogging",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999900001111:role/redwood-logging"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888899990000:key/hbr-222",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:project": "harbor"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

brenda_security: Also sent the redaction policy (we hash prompt/user_text fields with SHA256 and remove any PII regex matches) and told them raw prompt export requires a legal addendum.

own_sre: Canary plan: I'll run an object PUT from their VPC once SG rule is in. Staging numbers with S3 endpoint: median 27s to object available in Redwood S3. NAT path adds ~12s. If they need <40s SLA, endpoint is required.

marin_custadmin: Two asks from Harbor security: 1) can Object Lock be enabled for 5y WORM? 2) we need a short chain-of-custody doc for auditors showing who has Encrypt/Decrypt and rotation cadence.

brenda_security: Object Lock: yes we support Object Locked buckets and will provide example lifecycle + retention configuration. We'll recommend S3 Object Lock Governance with a 5y retention and recommend server-side verification steps for auditors.

kai_net: SG rule created: sg-082b7c6d. Shared ID in DM. VPCE is active.

brenda_security: Sent the chain-of-custody doc to marin (email). It explains: Harbor key allows Encrypt/GenerateDataKey to our logging role; Redwood account holds a Decrypt-capable KMS key for envelope decryption. Rotation: customer KMS rotate 90d (their policy), Redwood rotates our envelope key 30d. We record rotation events in audit logs.

marin_custadmin: Reviewing docs now. Two clarifications: 1) will hashed inputs be sufficient for our compliance report? 2) how do you prove non-repudiation of retention (we need tamper-evidence)?

brenda_security: Hashed inputs are default and acceptable for many audits; if you need raw prompts, we need a signed Addendum. For tamper-evidence: Object Lock + S3 access logs + KMS usage logs provide the chain. We'll include a simple verification checklist auditors can run.

own_sre: Canary run result: 200 OK from Harbor VPC -> collector, object available in Redwood S3 in 31s via VPCE. Marking canary PASS. :white_check_mark:

auditbot: Staging audit-forward job 2026-06-10T04:00:00Z: median 25s to staging S3; Object Lock test PASS.

dana_cs: Action items: 1) @brenda_security confirm KMS policy accepted by Harbor and paste final policy in thread, 2) @kai_net confirm VPCE + SG rule IDs in runbook, 3) @marin_custadmin confirm acceptance of hashed-only redaction or request addendum. Renewal status: marking "elevated" until KMS acceptance and signed retention doc. Please update thread when complete. :thumbsup:

marin_custadmin: We applied the KMS snippet with EncryptionContext and accepted hashed-only redaction for now. We'll escalate if auditors request raw prompts.

brenda_security: Confirmed key policy applied in Harbor account. Final policy attached to email and stored in runbook.

dana_cs: Thanks everyone. Moving renewal from "elevated" -> "monitor". Closing when we have signed retention attestation (expected next week).

auditbot: Retention-attestation reminder scheduled: 2026-06-17T09:00:00Z.
